newsitem.title: CHINA: China sentences two dissidents to labour reform.
newsitem.headline: China sentences two dissidents to labour reform.

text.p: China has sentenced two democracy activists to a labour camp for up to three years, accusing them of writing subversive materials, a fellow dissident said on Saturday.

Authorities in the city of Taiyuan in central China's Shanxi province had sentenced Fu Guoyong to three years of re-education through labour and fellow activist Chen Ping to one year, the dissident told Reuters by telephone.
"The reason was because they published articles abroad about democracy," said the dissident, who asked not to be identified.
Taiyuan police had detained Fu in July and had notified his family of the sentencing on November 19, he said.
Chen had been detained in Taiyuan in August and was sentenced at the same time as Fu, he said.
"They just wrote some articles. There really was no reason for this," he said in reference to the sentences.
